mappings.scope: Formal regime-relative computational achievability, impossibility, witness/method existence, reductions/transfer, comparative power and abstract constraint/resource structure; does not claim all Computer Science or all computation research.

Qualified cross-locus capability, composition/realization, structural interaction projection, service/satisfaction, reference-resolution and forwarding/reachability semantics. This overlaps the external Networking & Communication knowledge area but remains architecture-neutral and does not claim all networking research.

Runtime research directly studies execution, resource/isolation, interaction/composition, failure/persistence/reconciliation, evidence/truth scope and lifecycle/standing structures that overlap computer-systems fundamentals. It does not claim the full external Systems Fundamentals field.

Runtime execution/resource/isolation/lifecycle semantics overlap OS concerns such as process/execution, resource management, protection/isolation and lifecycle, but Ordivon Runtime is not a general Operating Systems research programme.

Reality/actuality, modality, causality, counterfactual/categorial structure and temporal/property semantics directly address a bounded metaphysical/reality subspace. World explicitly does not claim all Philosophy or a complete ontology of Reality.
Model/Reality firewalls, causal validation, property evaluation and evidence/claim structure overlap philosophy-of-science questions while remaining World-specific research semantics.

Context-relative constitutive/normative admission, consequence, competence/power and valid transformation overlap normative philosophy. The owner explicitly rejects universal normativity, generic reasons/value and generic institutions/governance, so this is narrower than Ethics & Value Theory as a whole.

Durable Task continuity, Journal/CAS, revision/lease fencing, bounded handoff/inspection, opaque-extension durability and operational-integrity responsibilities still lack a clean external coordinate after computing-system repair. Parallel/distributed coordination is adjacent but does not equal Host Task continuity semantics.

Current Game semantic Foundations and practical/game-specific research are real/current, but the bounded foundational Reference World intentionally does not yet contain Game Studies/Game Design/Play as normalized external identities.

SCD directly studies typed semantic responsibilities across observation, composition/context, comparison/refinement, abstraction, transport/preservation, admissibility, satisfaction, predicate transformation, dependency and evolution, while explicitly reusing framework-specific operational/denotational/axiomatic/type-system semantics rather than claiming those local theories as SCD inventions. This is a cross-framework semantics bridge, not whole Formal Semantics ownership.

SCD formalization and consumer dogfood use specification, refinement, abstract interpretation, verified transformation, type-system, satisfaction, dependency and proof-obligation techniques as mature external suppliers. SCD contributes owner-typed cross-framework responsibility/currentness coordination, not Formal Methods as a whole.

Human directly studies bounded psychological territory including consciousness/experience, attention/access, affect/regulation, memory/representation/reasoning, decision/action, relationships and multiple retained cognition projections. This is partial coverage, not whole Psychology.

Human contributes a broad Human-mind/cognition side spanning perception, memory, reasoning, decision, symbolic systems and retained temporal/quantitative/spatial/imagination projections, but Cognitive Science also includes AI, linguistics, anthropology, neuroscience, philosophy and education outside Human ownership.

HF2 is retained inside the current Boundary & Subjectivity family and Human owns Human-side consciousness/subjective-experience claims; deep imagination/reality-monitoring and bodily-self projections add bounded scientific depth. This does not cover all neural or philosophical theories of consciousness.

Human has direct affect/emotion/regulation research through the valuation-regulation-adaptation family and the HOC10 admission episode, where a missing affect/regulation operational object falsified prior HOC0-HOC9 sufficiency. Coverage remains Human-side and does not absorb clinical/medical/social-policy authority.

HF6 adaptation/plasticity/development supplies a stable Human-development concern, but Human does not claim the whole developmental-science field, child/family developmental research, education or developmental biology.

Human-side symbolic/generative-system structure and HD5 language work intersect language science, while communication-use remains separately bounded and Human does not own the full formal, descriptive, historical or sociolinguistic field.

Human research consumes and integrates brain/nervous-system evidence across consciousness, perception, affect and retained cognitive projections, but neural mechanism truth remains external neuroscience evidence and Human does not own neuroscience as a field.
HD7 genetics/heredity is retained as deep biological Human research with no peer Foundation promotion. This maps a bounded Human genetics/heredity interface, not genetics as a whole.
HD8 evolution/phylogeny/population-change is retained as deep Human research without Foundation promotion. This is a Human/evolution bridge, not ownership of evolutionary biology.

HD9 organismic systems/health/disease preserves physiological and functional Human depth, while operational HOC7 remains explicitly non-diagnostic. Human does not claim medicine or physiology wholesale.

Media directly studies structured mediation, signals, communication/exposure/protocol/publication/audience profiles and mediated relations, but Communication Studies also includes interpersonal, organizational, political, health, instructional and other communication domains outside Media owner scope.

Media owns structural mediation/representation/composition/experience semantics and derived publication/audience/remediation profiles, while external Media Studies additionally centers historical, cultural, aesthetic, industrial and interpretive analysis; Art/Expression/Studio remains explicitly adjacent-not-core.

MF3 Representation plus derived meaning/context/quotation/translation structures overlap signification and communication, but Semiotics ranges across language, philosophy, culture and biological sign systems not owned by Media.

Round-D interface/action coupling and mediated-presence/teleaction/embodiment structures overlap HCI interaction, feedback and experience concerns. Concrete interface design/usability, computing implementation and empirical human factors remain external or other-owner territory.

negativeNoveltyEvidence: Communication/exposure/protocol/publication/audience/meaning/archive/translation profiles survived as derived structures rather than MF10.
Round C falsified checklist-completion closure; fresh candidate continents were then directly reduced in Round D rather than promoted by novelty pressure.
Infrastructure, operative mediation, interface/action coupling and mediated presence remain typed derived/cross-owner structures, not new primitives.
Art/Expression/Studio is explicitly adjacent-not-core and cross-owner semantic dependency does not transfer authority.
Strong current research closure does not claim absolute whole-Media exhaustion.
